results.webTitle: Bank of England holds interest rates at 5.25%

fields.headline: Bank of England holds interest rates at 5.25%
fields.bodyText:
The Bank of England has held interest rates at 5.25% for the fifth meeting in a row.
Members of the monetary policy committee voted 8-1 to keep rates unchanged. One member voted for a cut.
Inflation fell to 4% in January, down from a peak of 11.1% in October 2022, but remains above the 2% target.

results.webTitle: Why the moon landing conspiracy theories persist

fields.headline: Why the moon landing conspiracy theories persist
fields.bodyText: Six Apollo missions landed humans on the moon between 1969 and 1972. Independent evidence includes retroreflectors still used by observatories today.
